**ID:** X1574
**Volume:** X83

**Byline:** 明 文琇集
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644

## Contributors
- 文琇 (A000178)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-juan supplemental continuation of the *Xù chuándēng lù* 續傳燈錄 ([KR6q0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0016)), adding Chán masters of the late Yuán and early Míng that the anonymous *Xù chuándēng lù* had not covered or had covered only thinly. Compiled by [文琇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E7%90%87) Nánshí Wénxiù, a Línjì-line monk active in the early Míng.

**Abstract**

One of the early-fifteenth-century responses to the perceived inadequacy of the anonymous *Xù chuándēng lù*'s treatment of the most recent generations: Wénxiù supplements its coverage with fuller entries on the Yuán-to-early-Míng Línjì line, to which he himself belonged. Compact in scale compared to the *Wǔdēng huìyuán xùlüè* 五燈會元續略 ([KR6q0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0013)) and *Wǔdēng yántǒng* 五燈嚴統 ([KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019)), but earlier in date and preserved in the Jiāxīng 嘉興 canon.
